instruction: Adjust the VLC progress bar slider colors to dark or black tones for a night-friendly theme.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC's slider colors to dark/blackish tones. The evaluator uses the existing check_qt_slider_colours function with type='blackish', which verifies that all RGB color values in qt-slider-colours are below the threshold (100) to ensure they are dark colors. This is similar in difficulty to the original task - both involve VLC interface customization through preference changes.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement - checking that VLC slider colors are dark/blackish tones
Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly extracts the VLC configuration file containing qt-slider-colours setting
Metric (check_qt_slider_colours with type='blackish') correctly parses RGB values and verifies all values are below threshold (100)
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config changes are persisted
Correct parameter handling - metric receives rules dict directly and accesses rule['type'] correctly
Complete coverage - evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires
